svg.title: Shadewright merge-time freshness check
svg.desc: Overview of ADR-0041, proposed. Built for #737: the check at the merge in all three paths, its reads and comparisons, and the Inconclusive end with StalePlanMerged. Not built: Preflight, the source checks, MergedAgainstPolicy and the check at every poll, so today a refused change or a deleted policy also ends Inconclusive with StalePlanMerged. When the executor sees that a person merged a pull request, it first checks freshness once more, from recorded state and three reads of the API server: the policy, the settings and the target, compared with the recorded policy UID and revision, plan repository, plan digest and target UID. It reads nothing from Git or Flux, because after the merge the file and the live value already hold the new value, and it compares no timestamps. A failed read is not fresh and not stale: the request keeps its phase and the next look retries. If nothing changed, the merge is recorded as today. If something changed, the same policy code is asked whether it refuses the change: Preflight (the field checks) and the source checks, run on the recorded source with no Git read. If they do not refuse it, the merge is recorded with PlanFresh False and the request ends Inconclusive with StalePlanMerged, which the circuit breaker does not count as a success. If they refuse it, or the policy was deleted, the request ends NeedsIntervention with the reason MergedAgainstPolicy, with the merge receipt kept and no outcome counted by the circuit breaker. A gone target or settings object ends Inconclusive without that question. The same reads also run at every poll before the merge, compare only, and close a stale pull request within one poll. In both stale cases Shadewright opens no revert proposal and makes no Git write; a person decides. With verification on, a failure still ends Failed. After the merge the file and the live value already hold the new value, so a previous-value test would be a false positive on every plan. The check reads no Git, no source mapping and no Flux, compares no timestamps and makes no Git write or revert proposal. The check runs when the merge is seen, at any time after a policy, settings or target change, which the executor notices at its next look (30 s to 5 min). In the Inconclusive case the cap ends it StalePlanMerged and the circuit breaker counts no outcome; with verification on, a failure still ends Failed. In the NeedsIntervention case the reason is MergedAgainstPolicy, the receipt is kept, and a person decides. svg.text: Recorded state only: no Git read, no Flux read, no timestamps compared, no Git write.
